title: Nvidia’s stock extends declines following harsh words from the U.S. government
html:
Tech Stocks

Nvidia’s stock extends declines following harsh words from the U.S. government

The Commerce Department announced a new rule aimed at restricting China’s remote access to advanced chips

Nvidia’s stock was falling Monday morning as investors continued to assess the fallout from Jensen Huang’s resignation as CEO and the growing scrutiny of the chip maker by the U.S. government.

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said during a Sunday appearance on Fox Business’s “Sunday Morning Futures” that the chip maker needs “a dramatic shakeup” in leadership following Huang’s departure on Thursday.
summary: The Commerce Department announced a new rule aimed at restricting China’s remote access to advanced chips.
